summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to follow the current Meridale v2 pages. It sends exactly one request with merchant_id, tz (canonical id; Etc/GMT offsets), from, to (half-open, first of next month) and locale (BCP 47, supported-locale fallback), and no deprecated parameters. Amounts are Decimal, rounded half-even to the currency's digits, and the text follows the locale rules; unit tests pass. Fixed offsets with non-zero minutes raise ValueError because the reference has no zone for them, and link names outside the doc table are handled only for a small built-in list.
